items.question: What is the Travel Guide for?
items.answer: This is JVTO's planning hub for safety rules, Ijen screening, closures/weather logic, packing/fitness, booking flow, and group escort context. It helps you prepare before departure.

items.question: What is the binding reference if anything differs?
items.answer: Your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF) is the highest authority for your specific booking. If anything differs, follow the document precedence stated on this page and in the policy pack.

items.question: Which pages should I read before paying?
items.answer: Read /travel-guide/booking-information, then /policy/booking-payment-cancellation and /policy/inclusions-exclusions. Use /travel-guide/weather-and-closures for route uncertainty.

items.question: Where can I find the Ijen screening process?
items.answer: Read /travel-guide/ijen-health-screening. Screening is part of Ijen night hike logistics when applicable and may be required by local rules.

items.question: What should I do close to departure?
items.answer: Re-check /travel-guide/packing-and-fitness and /travel-guide/weather-and-closures. If you are unsure how a rule applies, verify via official channels before travel.
